metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature over the Mesquite Flat higher than over the Panamint Mountains on June 30, 2013, as observed with Landsat 8?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 (Landsat 8 Level-2 Surface Temperature) - Date: June 30, 2013 - Location: Mesquite Flat (valley floor in Death Valley) vs Panamint Mountains (nearby mountain range) - Need to define two geometries for comparison 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA_PIXEL band to mask clouds and cloud shadows - Apply scale factors for temperature band (ST_B10) 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Temperature values should be in reasonable range (e.g., 250-350K or -23 to 77°C) - Check if images exist for both locations - Check if valid pixels remain after masking - Compare mean temperatures between the two regions - If Mesquite Flat temp > Panamint Mountains temp → A (Yes) - Otherwise → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries - Mesquite Flat (valley floor) and Panamint Mountains const mesquiteFlatGeom = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.0, 36.72]); const panamintGeom = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.1, 36.4]); // 2. Data acquisition const startDate = '2013-06-30'; const endDate = '2013-07-01'; let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(mesquiteFlatGeom.buffer(10000)); const colSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 images found for June 30, 2013'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } // 4. Get the image and apply scaling let image = collection.first(); image = maskClouds(image); const tempBand = image.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15); // 5. Calculate temperature for Mesquite Flat const mesquiteStats = await tempBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: mesquiteFlatGeom.buffer(1000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mesquiteTemp = mesquiteStats.ST_B10_mean; const mesquiteCount = mesquiteStats.ST_B10_count; console.log(`Mesquite Flat - Temp: ${mesquiteTemp?.toFixed(2)}°C, Pixels: ${mesquiteCount}`); // 6. Calculate temperature for Panamint Mountains const panamintStats = await tempBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: panamintGeom.buffer(1000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const panamintTemp = panamintStats.ST_B10_mean; const panamintCount = panamintStats.ST_B10_count; console.log(`Panamint Mountains - Temp: ${panamintTemp?.toFixed(2)}°C, Pixels: ${panamintCount}`); // 7. Validation and answer if (mesquiteCount === 0 || panamintCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mesquiteTemp === null || mesquiteTemp === undefined || panamintTemp === null || panamintTemp === undefined || mesquiteTemp < -50 || mesquiteTemp > 100 || panamintTemp < -50 || panamintTemp > 100) { console.log('Invalid temperature values'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Temperature difference: ${(mesquiteTemp - panamintTemp).toFixed(2)}°C`); if (mesquiteTemp > panamintTemp) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
